song.name: The Forgotten City
song.plot: The construction of Sanguine Vaults—a subterranean metropolis built beneath Eldoria's capital city, serving as the central headquarters and energy bank of the Crimson Covenant.
song.analysis: The original is a generic "spectral city" piece built on filler ("a spectral view", "a ghostly hue", "a darkness falls"). The reworked version anchors it to the actual arc (~220 BGD): Sanguine Vaults, the subterranean metropolis built by Acheron beneath Eldoria to house the Covenant's Soul-Bank, where vampire lords meet in council and soul-tithes are stored. Uniform 8-8-8-8 meter. Suggested song direction: atmospheric, mysterious, architectural — deep cavern reverb, stone echoes, low chamber-organ, cavernous percussion.
